Written for cold storage warehouses, blast and spiral freezer rooms, food processing plants, meat and poultry plants, dairies, ice cream plants and refrigerated distribution centers.

Why this sign matters

Keeps the defrost pressure regulator at the engineered setting so coils defrost fully without blowing hot gas straight to suction.

Where to post it

Mount on the valve group beside the defrost relief regulator on the evaporator suction side.

Who orders it

Refrigeration contractors, plant refrigeration engineers, cold storage facility managers, food plant maintenance leads, freezer and cooler operators.
